_meta.keyed_by: national dex number (as a string); `internal` is the ROM species index
_meta.rule: RARE = legendary OR special OR rate OR pseudo OR variant; shiny is its own branch
_meta.variant: ratio in [31, 63, 191], the minority gender, best_rate x P(minority) <= 4% (Q5, a stated interpretation); modules/rarity.py checks the individual
_meta.pseudo: exactly 1 MAPSEC AND >= 2 gates on the easiest home. A gate is an HM field move or a fishing rod needed to reach the encounter FROM THE STORY PATH (the Q6 proposal: a map the story walks through adds no gate, so Victory Road's species do not qualify; bikes are not gates)
_meta.map_access_source: Meteor Falls: sandbox-pokebot/modules/story/training_areas.py (measured 2026-09-11); Shoal Cave: tools/story-dev/probe_rarity_shoal_path.py (evidence/2026-09-29-rarepredicate-SHOALPATH.txt, production calculate_path). NOT a citation: tools/story-dev/probe_rarity_access_gates.py, whose pre-registered 262/299 control failed (296/333), so nothing it prints is believed
